crossRefs.note: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.”
“Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall…
How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
“Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.
They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.
Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
“Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
Whereas you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears…

translations.web: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
translations.bsb: Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!
translations.kjv: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
translations.asv: Oh remember how short my time is: For what vanity hast thou created all the children of men!
